answer: Agent Sponsorship Registry. Each agent identity must name a human or corporate sponsor who signs a fable of liability: if the agent is later proven to be one of many controlled by the same operator, the sponsor pays a penalty proportional to the swarm size, plus a fixed relic fee. Sponsors are capped at ten live identities and cannot re-sponsor after a violation. An attacker must recruit distinct sponsors per identity, each risking that penalty and opal-tier collateral.
